card.learned_from: Forensic Architecture（2010 起；同名书 2017）、《细细的蓝线》（1988）
card.line: 夜间图纸立成线框模型，时间码走动，一条路线穿过去，每个事件一个编号标注和出处
card.fit: 新闻复盘、事件经过、讲清一件事的时间线
card.score: 冷静的纪录片脉冲，E 小调
card.instruments: 低频长音、钟表滴答、毡锤钢琴单音
card.sounds_like: 扫描一口气，墙立起来一声上扬，每个编号一下清脆的点击

motion.scan: a vertical scan line crosses the frame in 0.95 s (in-out sine) and the model exists only behind it
motion.camera: top-down 90° tilting to about 52° pitch with a slow yaw; hand-projected pinhole, focal 1625 px at 40 m
motion.callout: ring, leader, plate in 0.3 s (out-cubic); number block first, then time and source, then what happened

study.work: Forensic Architecture (research agency) and Forensic Architecture: Violence at the Threshold of Detectability
study.by: Eyal Weizman (Goldsmiths, University of London); Zone Books
